landmarks.name: Cave Entrance
landmarks.description: Roots grip the limestone where daylight fades behind the keeper rail. Crystal seams mark the way into the galleries.

landmarks.name: Vein Gallery
landmarks.description: Dry stone opens between fissured walls. A side route curls toward reflecting water, while the main passage continues deeper.

landmarks.name: Reflecting Grotto
landmarks.description: Still water mirrors the tiny crystals above it. The dry bank winds around the pool and rejoins the upper passage.

landmarks.name: Upper Passage
landmarks.description: A dry passage curves away from the grotto toward Splitstone Hollow. Broken stone and scattered pebbles line its edges.

landmarks.name: Splitstone Hollow
landmarks.description: Split columns and hanging stone mark a broad junction. The dry route continues deeper; a damp branch bends toward old keeper stonework.

landmarks.name: High Overlook
landmarks.description: A short ramp climbs to a ledge overlooking Splitstone Hollow. Return down the ramp to continue through the junction.

landmarks.name: Keeper's Recess
landmarks.description: Worn paving and a weathered memorial preserve traces of the Sanctuary keepers. The damp route continues around to the deeper gallery.

landmarks.name: Deep Passage
landmarks.description: Wet cracks and scattered pebbles line this lower passage. Follow its bend toward the Deep Gallery.

landmarks.name: Deep Gallery
landmarks.description: Stone formations draw close around the route. Colored seams lead onward toward a sheltered ledge.

landmarks.name: Quiet Shelf
landmarks.description: A sheltered stone ledge offers a quiet pause before the final chamber. The passage ahead opens beyond the hanging stone.

landmarks.name: Echo Chamber
landmarks.description: A fresh rupture yawns beneath the crystal-lined vault. Claw-scored limestone and rising threads of aether hint at a deeper subterranean world.

landmarks.name: Embervein Chamber
landmarks.description: An offshoot bends into a warm chamber where countless red microcrystals glimmer inside fractured limestone. Ember light gathers around a solitary elemental.

landmarks.name: Stillfrost Chamber
landmarks.description: A quiet side chamber glows with white and blue pinpricks embedded in its walls. Pale mineral crust and damp stone catch the cold light around a waiting elemental.

inspections.label: Examine the pool
inspections.text: Tiny crystals shimmer in the water. The dry bank continues around the pool.

inspections.label: Read the weathered memorial
inspections.text: The worn marks honor those who came here to guide the dead home.

inspections.label: Take in the quiet ledge
inspections.text: A sheltered ledge before the chamber. We should make sure we are ready before going farther.

inspections.label: Examine the rupture
inspections.text: Aether rises from the newly broken floor. There is no safe route down.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: Those marks go all the way up the rock. Something climbed out.

dialogue.speaker: caelan
dialogue.text: I can feel aether rising from below.

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.text: We’d need proper equipment to get down there.
